from collections import Counter

def main():
    st = input("Enter the String")
    counts = Counter(st)
    pieces = []
    for i in range(256):
        ch = chr(i)
        n = counts.get(ch, 0)
        if n > 0:
            pieces.append(ch if n == 1 else ch + str(n))
    print("".join(pieces), end="")

main()

import subprocess
import sys

def main():
    command = [sys.argv[1]]
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    for line in process.stdout:
        print(line.rstrip("\n"))
    process.wait()
    print("Program terminated!")

main()

class Animal:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

    def __lt__(self, other):
        return self.name < other.name

    def __repr__(self):
        return self.name

Cat = Animal("Cat")
Mouse = Animal("Mouse")
Dog = Animal("Dog")
Horse = Animal("Horse")
Tiger = Animal("Tiger")
Lion = Animal("Lion")

def main():

    list2 = [Dog, Mouse, Cat]
    list3 = [Dog, Horse, Cat]
    list4 = [Dog, Tiger, Lion]
    lists = [list1, list2, list3, list4]

    for animals in lists:

        if ordered not in seen:
            seen.add(ordered)
